description: This file contains PHP functions for minifying HTML and CSS content, including a Smarty plugin function for minifying HTML output within templates.

methods.name: smarty_block_minify
methods.description: Smarty plugin function that minifies HTML content, including inline CSS, by removing whitespace, comments, and optimizing tags.

methods.name: fn_minify_css
methods.description: Minifies CSS code by removing unnecessary whitespace, comments, and optimizing color codes and other syntax.

methods.name: minify_css
methods.description: Minifies CSS input, preserving important whitespace in calc() functions, and removing unnecessary characters.

methods.name: __minify_v
methods.description: Helper function that replaces whitespace characters with their minimized equivalents.
